name: justanotherspy
description: Central marketplace for justanotherspy's Claude Code plugins, each sourced from its home repo.

plugins.name: shuck
plugins.description: Get the exact failing CI step logs for a GitHub PR via the shuck CLI — /shuck skill + local MCP server (inspect_logs / inspect_reviews / inspect_security / inspect_action).

plugins.name: garlic
plugins.description: Ward off AI burnout: tracks active Claude Code time via hooks and nudges you to take breaks, plus a /garlic status command. Requires the garlic binary on PATH.

plugins.name: sproot
plugins.description: Convert setup bash scripts into sproot.yaml modules, and author/explain/validate sproot configs - /sproot:script-convert + /sproot:author-config skills.

plugins.name: output-styles
plugins.description: A collection of output styles for Claude Code. Includes ASD-STE100, Simplified Technical English for agent prose: one meaning per word, active voice, simple tenses, short sentences.
